description: Reports whether Shodan's pre-collected passive scan data shows NTP (port 123) seen open on an IPv4 address. Passive and possibly old; the monlist amplification check itself is not run, so this cannot say whether monlist is enabled. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_ntp_monlist_audit
title: Security Ntp Monlist Audit
